admission.justification: Tokenizer, descriptor validation, per-candidate admission and page policy jointly prevent comma-bearing forbidden addresses from becoming fetches or suppressing permitted neighbors.

applicability: HTML source-set parsing and candidate media admission in rendered repository documents, together with their media referrer policy.
conditions: URL and descriptor tokenization occurs before the caller admits each parsed candidate.
Invalid descriptors discard their candidate; parsing resumes after the delimiter recognized by the tokenizer.
An unclosed parentheses state consumes the remaining input.
The document page policy suppresses media referrers for elements without an individual policy attribute.
exclusions: Splitting comma-bearing URLs into independent candidates.
A parser decision that by itself authorizes a network fetch.
